rationale: Budderfly is a qualifying US energy-as-a-service infrastructure platform. Partners Group closed a majority investment in July 2022 and remains current, with management retaining minority equity. Edison exited; Balance Point is reported as exited. However, Connecticut Innovations' current post-recapitalization status, exact ownership percentages, definitive fund allocation and the LP/LLP legal-style discrepancy remain unresolved, so the research is staged but not mutation-ready.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Budderfly platform only after the remaining identity and active-owner questions are resolved.
Add Partners Group as the current majority owner from 2022-07-01.
Treat management as a current minority owner without inventing a percentage.
Record Edison Partners and Balance Point as former owners.
Do not represent debt/project-capital financings or customer equipment SPVs as new equity owners.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact Partners Group and minority ownership percentages, purchase price, signing date, seller set and primary/secondary split.
Definitive Partners Group infrastructure fund allocation beyond the documented PGPE co-investment.
Connecticut Innovations' current equity/instrument status and Balance Point rollover.
Definitive Encore Holdings LP versus LLP legal style.
